candidates.sql:
CREATE TABLE candidates (
                    item_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES items(id), normalized_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                    classification TEXT NOT NULL, reasons TEXT NOT NULL, classifier_version TEXT NOT NULL, entity_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNKNOWN', rule_score INTEGER, score_basis TEXT, evidence_news TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', classified_at TEXT)

classification_history.sql:
CREATE TABLE classification_history (
                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, item_id INTEGER REFERENCES items(id),
                    recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL, result_json TEXT NOT NULL)

instagram_analysis_observations.sql:
CREATE TABLE instagram_analysis_observations (
                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, hashtag_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES instagram_hashtags(id),
                    media_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES instagram_media(id),
                    run_id INTEGER REFERENCES instagram_runs(id), observed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                    caption_state TEXT NOT NULL, caption_hash TEXT, hashtag_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    extractor_version TEXT NOT NULL, evidence_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
                    UNIQUE(hashtag_id,media_id,observed_at))

instagram_candidate_hashtags.sql:
CREATE TABLE instagram_candidate_hashtags (
                    candidate_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES candidates(item_id),
                    hashtag_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES instagram_hashtags(id),
                    PRIMARY KEY(candidate_id,hashtag_id))

instagram_caption_analysis.sql:
CREATE TABLE instagram_caption_analysis (
                    media_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES instagram_media(id),
                    caption_state TEXT NOT NULL, caption_hash TEXT,
                    extractor_version TEXT NOT NULL, analyzed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                    hashtag_count INTEGER NOT NULL)

instagram_caption_tags.sql:
CREATE TABLE instagram_caption_tags (
                    media_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES instagram_media(id),
                    normalized_name TEXT NOT NULL, original_names TEXT NOT NULL,
                    first_seen TEXT NOT NULL, last_seen TEXT NOT NULL, active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
                    PRIMARY KEY(media_id,normalized_name))

instagram_hashtag_media.sql:
CREATE TABLE instagram_hashtag_media (
                    hashtag_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES instagram_hashtags(id),
                    media_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES instagram_media(id),
                    first_seen TEXT NOT NULL, last_seen TEXT NOT NULL,
                    PRIMARY KEY(hashtag_id,media_id))

instagram_hashtags.sql:
CREATE TABLE instagram_hashtags (
                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, user_id TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL,
                    instagram_id TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, last_searched_at TEXT,
                    active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, approved_at TEXT,
                    UNIQUE(user_id,name))

instagram_leases.sql:
CREATE TABLE instagram_leases (
                    user_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner TEXT NOT NULL, expires_at TEXT NOT NULL)

instagram_media.sql:
CREATE TABLE instagram_media (
                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, published_at TEXT, first_seen TEXT NOT NULL,
                    last_seen TEXT NOT NULL, media_type TEXT, permalink TEXT,
                    source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'instagram_graph', caption TEXT, caption_captured_at TEXT, caption_purged_at TEXT)

instagram_metrics.sql:
CREATE TABLE instagram_metrics (
                    hashtag_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES instagram_hashtags(id),
                    grain TEXT NOT NULL, bucket TEXT NOT NULL, new_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    run_count INTEGER NOT NULL, successful_runs INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    PRIMARY KEY(hashtag_id,grain,bucket))

instagram_observation_tags.sql:
CREATE TABLE instagram_observation_tags (
                    observation_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES instagram_analysis_observations(id),
                    normalized_name TEXT NOT NULL, original_names TEXT NOT NULL,
                    active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
                    PRIMARY KEY(observation_id,normalized_name))

instagram_runs.sql:
CREATE TABLE instagram_runs (
                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, hashtag_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES instagram_hashtags(id),
                    started_at TEXT NOT NULL, finished_at TEXT, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'running',
                    request_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, returned_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    new_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, duplicate_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    error_type TEXT, error_code INTEGER, error_subcode INTEGER,
                    truncated INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

instagram_searches.sql:
CREATE TABLE instagram_searches (
                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, user_id TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL,
                    instagram_id TEXT, searched_at TEXT NOT NULL)

instagram_state.sql:
CREATE TABLE instagram_state (
                    user_id TEXT NOT NULL, key TEXT NOT NULL, value TEXT NOT NULL,
                    PRIMARY KEY(user_id,key))

items.sql:
CREATE TABLE items (
                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, source_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, keyword TEXT NOT NULL,
                    published_at TEXT, first_seen TEXT NOT NULL, last_seen TEXT NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL)

naver_calls.sql:
CREATE TABLE naver_calls (
                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, day TEXT NOT NULL, fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
                    requested_at TEXT NOT NULL, finished_at TEXT, status TEXT NOT NULL,
                    http_status INTEGER, request_json TEXT NOT NULL, candidate_ids TEXT NOT NULL)

naver_guards.sql:
CREATE TABLE naver_guards (
                    fingerprint TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner TEXT NOT NULL, until_epoch REAL NOT NULL)

naver_targets.sql:
CREATE TABLE naver_targets (
                    candidate_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES candidates(item_id),
                    topic TEXT NOT NULL, keywords_json TEXT NOT NULL,
                    last_attempt_at TEXT, last_success_at TEXT, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending')

observations.sql:
CREATE TABLE observations (
                    run_id INTEGER REFERENCES runs(id), item_id INTEGER REFERENCES items(id),
                    payload TEXT NOT NULL, classification_json TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(run_id,item_id))

runs.sql:
CREATE TABLE runs (
                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, started_at TEXT NOT NULL, finished_at TEXT,
                    success INTEGER, error TEXT, http_status INTEGER, item_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                    new_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0, warnings TEXT, raw_response BLOB, food_count INTEGER, review_count INTEGER, new_food_count INTEGER, new_review_count INTEGER, classifier_version TEXT)

youtube_calls.sql:
CREATE TABLE youtube_calls (
                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, day TEXT NOT NULL, endpoint TEXT NOT NULL,
                    query_id INTEGER REFERENCES youtube_queries(id), started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                    finished_at TEXT, status TEXT NOT NULL, http_status INTEGER, origin TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'legacy_unknown', run_id TEXT, result_count INTEGER)

youtube_candidate_foods.sql:
CREATE TABLE youtube_candidate_foods (
                    candidate_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES candidates(item_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                    food_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES youtube_foods(id))

youtube_foods.sql:
CREATE TABLE youtube_foods (
                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE)

youtube_matches.sql:
CREATE TABLE youtube_matches (
                    query_id INTEGER REFERENCES youtube_queries(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                    video_id TEXT REFERENCES youtube_videos(video_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                    matched_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(query_id,video_id))

youtube_queries.sql:
CREATE TABLE youtube_queries (
                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, query TEXT NOT NULL, mode TEXT NOT NULL,
                    food_id INTEGER REFERENCES youtube_foods(id), active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
                    after_at TEXT, before_at TEXT, page_token TEXT, token_at TEXT, last_attempt TEXT,
                    UNIQUE(query,mode))

youtube_runs.sql:
CREATE TABLE youtube_runs (
                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, started_at TEXT NOT NULL, finished_at TEXT,
                    trigger TEXT NOT NULL, origin TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL,
                    result_json TEXT)

youtube_state.sql:
CREATE TABLE youtube_state (
                    key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)

youtube_video_provenance.sql:
CREATE TABLE youtube_video_provenance (
                    video_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES youtube_videos(video_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                    origin TEXT NOT NULL, verified_at TEXT NOT NULL, run_id TEXT)

youtube_videos.sql:
CREATE TABLE youtube_videos (
                    video_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, payload TEXT NOT NULL, collected_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                    refreshed_at TEXT NOT NULL, expires_at TEXT NOT NULL)

rss_classes.sql: SELECT classification,count(*) n FROM candidates GROUP BY classification

rss_runs.sql: SELECT success,http_status,count(*) n,sum(item_count) returned,sum(new_count) new_items FROM runs GROUP BY success,http_status

rss_times.sql: SELECT min(first_seen) first_seen,max(last_seen) last_seen,min(published_at) first_published,max(published_at) last_published,count(DISTINCT keyword) distinct_keywords FROM items

rss_missing.sql: SELECT sum(published_at IS NULL) missing_publication,sum(keyword='') empty_keyword,sum(first_seen>last_seen) reversed_time FROM items

rss_history.sql: SELECT count(*) total,sum(classification_json IS NULL) missing_classification FROM observations

rss_unclassified.sql: SELECT count(*) n FROM items i LEFT JOIN candidates c ON c.item_id=i.id WHERE c.item_id IS NULL

rss_keyword_repeats.sql: SELECT count(*) repeated_names,sum(n-1) extra_items FROM (SELECT keyword,count(*) n FROM items GROUP BY keyword HAVING count(*)>1)

rss_failures.sql: SELECT id,http_status,item_count,new_count,raw_response IS NOT NULL has_raw FROM runs WHERE success=0

ig_runs.sql: SELECT status,error_type,truncated,count(*) n,sum(returned_count) returned,sum(new_count) new_rows,sum(duplicate_count) duplicate_rows,sum(request_count) requests FROM instagram_runs GROUP BY status,error_type,truncated

ig_times.sql: SELECT min(first_seen) first_seen,max(last_seen) last_seen,min(published_at) first_published,max(published_at) last_published FROM instagram_media

ig_missing.sql: SELECT count(*) total,sum(caption IS NULL) missing_caption,sum(published_at IS NULL) missing_publication,sum(permalink IS NULL) missing_link,sum(media_type IS NULL) missing_type,sum(caption_purged_at IS NOT NULL) purged FROM instagram_media

ig_caption_states.sql: SELECT caption_state,count(*) n FROM instagram_caption_analysis GROUP BY caption_state

ig_evidence.sql: SELECT evidence_kind,count(*) n FROM instagram_analysis_observations GROUP BY evidence_kind

ig_tags.sql: SELECT id,name,active,(SELECT count(*) FROM instagram_candidate_hashtags ch WHERE ch.hashtag_id=h.id) linked_candidates FROM instagram_hashtags h

ig_co_tags.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT normalized_name) n FROM instagram_observation_tags WHERE active=1

ig_multi_tags.sql: SELECT count(*) n FROM (SELECT media_id FROM instagram_hashtag_media GROUP BY media_id HAVING count(*)>1)

ig_metric_totals.sql: SELECT grain,sum(new_count) new_count,sum(run_count) runs,sum(successful_runs) successful FROM instagram_metrics GROUP BY grain

naver_calls.sql: SELECT status,http_status,count(*) n FROM naver_calls GROUP BY status,http_status

naver_times.sql: SELECT min(requested_at) first_attempt,max(requested_at) last_attempt FROM naver_calls

naver_user_queries.sql: SELECT candidate_ids,count(*) n FROM naver_calls GROUP BY candidate_ids

yt_calls.sql: SELECT endpoint,origin,status,http_status,count(*) n,sum(result_count) result_rows FROM youtube_calls GROUP BY endpoint,origin,status,http_status

yt_queries.sql: SELECT mode,active,count(*) n,sum(food_id IS NOT NULL) linked_food FROM youtube_queries GROUP BY mode,active

yt_runs.sql: SELECT origin,status,count(*) n FROM youtube_runs GROUP BY origin,status

yt_provenance.sql: SELECT coalesce(p.origin,'legacy_unknown') origin,count(*) n FROM youtube_videos v LEFT JOIN youtube_video_provenance p USING(video_id) GROUP BY coalesce(p.origin,'legacy_unknown')

yt_times.sql: SELECT min(collected_at) first_collected,max(refreshed_at) last_refreshed,min(expires_at) earliest_expiry FROM youtube_videos

yt_expired.sql: SELECT count(*) n FROM youtube_videos WHERE expires_at<=?

yt_matches.sql: SELECT q.mode,count(*) matches,count(DISTINCT m.video_id) unique_videos FROM youtube_matches m JOIN youtube_queries q ON q.id=m.query_id GROUP BY q.mode

ig_duplicate_ids.sql: SELECT count(*)-count(DISTINCT id) n FROM instagram_media

rss_duplicate_ids.sql: SELECT count(*)-count(DISTINCT source_id) n FROM items

yt_duplicate_ids.sql: SELECT count(*)-count(DISTINCT video_id) n FROM youtube_videos
